generationPolicy: One standalone icon per built-in ImageGen call. No paid provider, CLI fallback, SVG substitute, sheet slicing, or source image editing.
sourceRetention: Generated outputs copied byte-for-byte; original generated files retained.
referencePolicy: The following images were inspected for material direction. They were not sent as edit targets or supplied as tool image arguments; these are separate new assets.

inspectedReferences.role: Existing production Story emblem material reference

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production raster utility icon for the Starfall iOS game, rendered as a tactile shallow 3D observatory object. This is one isolated icon, not a sheet or UI mockup.
Style: polished pearl enamel faces, restrained warm brass bevels and deep midnight navy edges or inset accents. Broad clean surfaces, crisp readable silhouette, minimal texture, subtle depth. Warm light from upper left, controlled soft highlight on the face, darker lower-right edge. Match a premium celestial game instrument, with the handcrafted enamel-and-brass character of a small observatory lantern.
Composition: square image, perfectly centered, straight-on front view with no perspective tilt. Main silhouette occupies about 75 percent of the square at its largest dimension. Generous empty margins on all sides. The icon must read at 24–32 points.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the icon. No painted background and no shadow plane.
Constraints: only the one requested icon. No words, labels, letters, digits, watermark, tile, badge, enclosing circle, decorative outer frame, particles, stars in the background, sparks, luminous aura, glow halo, scene or backdrop. Do not reproduce a reference sheet or slice a mockup. Keep bevels restrained and shape bold.
Subject: one bold checkmark / tick, made of a solid softly rounded pearl-enamel face with a narrow restrained brass bevel and a thin dark navy depth edge. Short left descending stroke joins the long rising right stroke into one connected unmistakable check silhouette. Keep the V-like elbow broad and the tips compact. No circle or enclosing object.

alpha.note: Low-alpha fringe pixels extend beyond the visible subject; original master is unchanged. Deterministic export owns crop/normalization.
